title: Mixed Event — The Moon Rabbit & Us — Episode1 Something for the New Season

meta.Episode: Episode1 — Something for the New Season
meta.Event Outline: With MORE MORE JUMP!'s next stream approaching, Shizuku starts thinking of autumn-themed ideas, triggering childhood memories of when she went moon viewing with Shiho. She invites her sister to go together once again...

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Another exhausting practice...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Nice work, everyone.
We got quite a lot done today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Your technique is so beautiful, Asahina. I learned so much just by watching you.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you, I'm glad you thought so.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member B
rows.Line:
She's so right!
But you did really well too, Hinomori. You don't look tired at all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, Hinomori, you emptied quite a few quivers. Are you sure you're not tired?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm fine.
I am a little tired, but I feel like I can keep going as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Being an idol and all, I'm not always able to be here, so I also need to work harder than most to make up for that lost time.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's very commendable.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member A
rows.Line: Yeah, even though you're busy as an idol, you still find the time to put in the work here. If I don't do the same, you'll end up leaving me behind!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. I'll try my best to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But for now, let's all go home and get some rest. We can continue next time we meet.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member A
rows.Line:
Okay!
Bye, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Archery Club Member B
rows.Line: See you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It was so nice to be able to focus on this for once.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Let's see... Next, I have to start thinking of ideas for our stream.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What would be good for our next segment...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Everyone else always comes up with such wonderful ideas, so I'm hoping to be able to contribute this time!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But still...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Oh, I know...!
We could have a squeaky-clean cleaning contest or a blindfolded udon tasting challenge!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Doing a cleaning contest would also be a nice way to straighten out our rooms as well...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The udon challenge would even mean that we'd get to try different kinds of noodles too...! That sounds wonderfully delicious...!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I feel like I can still do better...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Is everything okay, Hinomori? Is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, Asahina...
It's nothing, but I appreciate your concern.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh? If you say so...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But if there is something on your mind, don't hesitate to ask me for help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Asahina...
Thank you, I think I'll take you up on that offer.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm trying to come up with some ideas regarding what my idol group should do next.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Your idol group...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Asahina...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry...
I've never been asked about anything like this before, so I was caught a little off guard.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Um... I don't know much about idols, so I'm not sure how much I'll be able to help... But I'd like to hear what's on your mind if that's okay with you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Just talking may even help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I see...
Alright, we can try that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
So you need ideas for your stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. The other girls in my group are always coming up with such great ideas, so I was hoping that maybe I could this time...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. That's so thoughtful of you, Hinomori.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I'd like to help somehow...
Hmm... Ideas for your stream...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, what if you did something with some seasonal flair to it?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Seasonal flair?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Yes. Fall is just about upon us, so it might be nice to introduce some seasonal desserts or even just books that you might recommend...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, moon viewing as well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Moon viewing...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Shii and I used to do those all the time when we were little. We haven't done one in quite a while since we've grown older...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I think this is the best I can do for now. I wish I could've done better.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
No, you were enormously helpful.
I do think something seasonal is the way to go!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Videos involving food also rarely ever disappoint and we'd get to introduce the things we like, so it sounds like a wonderful plan.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But moon viewing...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (If possible, I'd really like to do that with Shii...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You've given me some great ideas, Asahina. Thank you so much.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Don't mention it.
I'm just glad that I was able to help.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, it's getting pretty late...
I need to head to cram school soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to your stream.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, again, thank you!
Please be safe.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm so glad I asked her about this. She gave me so many good ideas...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Once I get home, I should put pen to paper and sort them all out.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But before I do that...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Maybe I can spend some time looking for that photo.
